fields.value: NETGEAR, Inc. ("NETGEAR"; Amendment #2: "Vendor") and Ingram Micro / INGRAM MICRO INC. ("Distributor"; Amendment #2: "Ingram"), with Distributor acting on behalf of itself and affiliates

quotes.text:
This Amendment is entered into effective October 1,1996 ("Amendment Date") by
and between NETGEAR, Inc. ("NETGEAR"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Bay
Networks, Inc., and Ingram Micro ("Distributor") acting on behalf of itself and
its affiliates.

THIS AMENDMENT (the "Amendment") is entered into this 15th day of July 1998,
by and between INGRAM MICRO INC. ("Ingram") and NETGEAR, INC. ("Vendor").

NETGEAR and Distributor having previously entered into a Distributor Agreement
("Agreement") with an Effective Date of March 1,1996, now mutually agree to
amend that Agreement as follows:

This Amendment is entered into effective October 1,1996 ("Amendment Date") by
and between NETGEAR, Inc. ("NETGEAR"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Bay
Networks, Inc., and Ingram Micro ("Distributor") acting on behalf of itself and
its affiliates.

The parties have agreed to amend their Distribution Agreement ("Agreement")
dated October 1,1996.

ambiguities: AMENDMENT states the prior Distributor Agreement has an Effective Date of March 1,1996, but the same Amendment is effective October 1,1996 and AMENDMENT #2 describes the Distribution Agreement as dated October 1,1996.

fields.value: Renewal or extension terms are contemplated, but no automatic-renewal or written-renewal mechanism is stated in the supplied text.

quotes.text:
2. This Amendment shall remain in effect for the current term and any
renewal term of the Agreement.

Following the [*],
for any extension or renewal term, Distributor's appointment as
Distributor shall be non-exclusive and NETGEAR may appoint other
distributors in [*] at its sole discretion.

ambiguities: Clause 2 of AMENDMENT #2 says the Amendment remains effective for the current term and any renewal term, and clause 2 of the AMENDMENT refers to any extension or renewal term, but neither clause states how a renewal occurs or whether it is automatic.

fields.value: Initial one-year sole distributorship for Ingram Micro in redacted territory [*], subject to mutually agreed marketing activities; NETGEAR may sell or license Products to non-distributor customers; after the redacted period/any extension or renewal term, the appointment is non-exclusive.

quotes.text:
2. During the initial one year period beginning on the Amendment Date,
Distributor shall be the only distributor appointed by NETGEAR in [*],
subject to Distributor conducting mutually agreed to marketing
activities as described in the Marketing Plan for [*] to be developed
and agreed to by and between the parties and which shall be attached to
and made a part of this Agreement as Exhibit 4a. For the purposes of
this provision, distributor shall mean a company acquiring products
directly from NETGEAR for resale or license to dealers or other second
tier resellers which in turn resell or license the products to end use
customers. The foregoing notwithstanding, during the [*] and any
subsequent period, NETGEAR reserves the right to sell or license
Products in [*] to customers other than distributors such as, but not
limited to resellers who procure Products at centralized locations for
resale to end-use customers solely through their wholly or majority
owned retail outlets, both store-front and catalog. Following the [*],
for any extension or renewal term, Distributor's appointment as
Distributor shall be non-exclusive and NETGEAR may appoint other
distributors in [*] at its sole discretion.

ambiguities: Clause 2 redacts the territory as [*], so the country or region cannot be identified from the supplied text.

Clause 2 makes the initial sole-distributor status subject to Distributor conducting mutually agreed marketing activities in a Marketing Plan for [*] to be developed and agreed; that plan is not included in the supplied text.
Clause 2 redacts the period in the phrases 'during the [*]' and 'Following the [*]', so the exact trigger for the later non-exclusive period is not visible.
